name: odonnell-2008-india-u5
title: Under-five deaths in India, 1982–92 (O'Donnell et al. 2008, Table 8.1)

sources.title: O'Donnell, van Doorslaer, Wagstaff and Lindelow, Analyzing Health Equity Using Household Survey Data, World Bank, 2008, Table 8.1
Open Knowledge Repository record (CC BY 3.0 IGO)

moveq.original: The concentration index of under-five deaths by wealth quintile in India, 1982–92, is −0.1694.
moveq.moveq_question: Does moveq's covariance concentration index on Table 8.1 match the published −0.1694?
limitations: Five wealth-quintile rows from Table 8.1, not NFHS microdata. The published −0.1694 is the grouped Kakwani (8.4) sum printed in that table.
moveq uses the covariance form of the same index on the five U5MR rows weighted by births. That form agrees with −0.1694 to the four decimal places the book reports.
U5MR is printed to one decimal place; implied deaths are integer. Using death rates (deaths/births) instead of U5MR changes the fifth decimal only.
The measure is descriptive, not causal. Redistribution of this table is not an endorsement by the World Bank.
